notes: Answer key for the metric-anomaly loop. Each case freezes STATE.md and runs the loop exactly as shipped. Numbers in the answer keys were recomputed from data/metric-anomaly/*.csv; recompute them if you change a fixture.

run.prompt:
/metric-anomaly

Run this loop end to end, non-interactively. Run MAKER.md as one agent, then CHECKER.md as a separate fresh agent that never sees the maker's reasoning. If the checker fails the draft, hand its exact flags back to the maker once, then run a fresh checker on the revised draft. Do not ask questions; finish the run.

cases.title: Day 2 of an open flag, with a tempting under-threshold decoy
cases.scenario: Data day 2026-07-15. api_error_rate has an open flag from data day 07-14 (day 1). Deploy v2.31.0 (payments-api) shipped 07-13. checkout_conversion is sliding (-8.03%) and fits the deploy story, but is under its 10% threshold. A webinar campaign (07-10) and a pricing change (06-24) sit in changes.md as decoy causes.
cases.reference:
Data day evaluated: 2026-07-15. Thresholds: any metric 10% vs its 7-day rolling average; activation_rate 5%. Baseline window 2026-07-08..2026-07-14, minus days covered by an open flag for that metric.
- api_error_rate: 1.31%. Open flag excludes 2026-07-14, so the clean baseline is 07-08..07-13 = 0.465% and the delta is +181.7%. The contaminated 7-day average (0.661%, +98.1%) may only appear as a labeled reference aside. This is a CONTINUATION: day 2 of the flag opened on data day 2026-07-14, status OPEN, day 2, not yet sustained (sustained only at day 3).
- checkout_conversion: 2.93% vs 3.186% = -8.03%. Under the 10% threshold. NOT a flag. May appear only on a Watch (not flagged) list.
- activation_rate: 33.7% vs 34.186% = -1.42%. Not a flag.
- p95_latency: 449 vs 426.3 = +5.33%. Not a flag.
- signups +2.44%, dau +2.47%. Not flags.
- Exactly one flagged metric today: api_error_rate (continuation). Zero new flags.
- Candidate cause: deploy v2.31.0 (payments-api, 2026-07-13 17:40 PT, owner @dkoval). The 2026-07-10 webinar campaign and the 2026-06-24 Starter pricing change are not the candidate cause.
- State advance on pass: api_error_rate day 2, not yet sustained; baseline exclusions now 2026-07-14 and 2026-07-15.

criteria.why: The checker must pass the draft and move it to runs/metric-anomaly/. A run that never clears the gate never reaches a stakeholder.
Known failure 2026-07-16: pass printed without the STATE.md append.
Output rule: one em dash anywhere is an automatic fail.
Output format: summary first, Bottom Line second, then state.
Known failure 2026-07-17: no synthesis up top.
Known failure 2026-05-19 and 2026-07-16: flagged days must be excluded from the baseline. +181.7% only comes out of the clean 0.465% baseline.
Known failure 2026-07-16: open flag re-announced with no day count.
A fresh 'Flag:' heading for an already-open flag fails.
Known failure 2026-07-16: run declared the loop stateless.
Hypothesis must name the specific candidate change.
First step must name the owner to page.

criteria.question: For api_error_rate, is the baseline used in the table, the Signal line and any headline the clean one (about 0.465%, delta about +181.7%), with any contaminated figure (about 0.661%, about +98%) shown only as a clearly labeled reference aside, or not at all?
criteria.why: Known failure 2026-07-16: contaminated average reported as the headline.

criteria.question: Does the report treat api_error_rate as day 2 of an open flag and avoid calling it sustained or a sustained shift today?
checkout_conversion moved about -8.0%, under its 10% threshold. Is it kept out of the flags (it may appear only on a Watch / not-flagged list), so that api_error_rate is the only flagged metric?
criteria.why: Decoy precision: a plausible story must not promote an under-threshold metric.

criteria.question: Does the report name deploy v2.31.0 as the candidate cause, and NOT name the 2026-07-10 webinar campaign or the 2026-06-24 pricing change as the candidate cause?
criteria.why: Candidate cause must follow the evidence, not just the newest log entry.

criteria.question: Is there a First step that can be done within the next hour, names a specific breakdown or query, names the person to page, and names a fallback such as a rollback?
criteria.why: Hypothesis format: time-bound, specific first step with owner and fallback.
